description.value:
You throw a hybrid tech-biotic device that projects a localized mass-effect lift field on detonation, suspending targets in the air.

Choose a point within 60 feet. All creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:15]{15-foot burst} centered on that point must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-lift-grenade] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target is lifted 5 feet off the ground and becomes Off-Guard until the end of your next turn.

Failure The target is lifted 10 feet and becomes Grabbed (suspended by the biotic field). The Grabbed condition ends at the start of your next turn or when the target Escapes (DC equals the creature's power DC).

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[void]] damage and is Stunned 1.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
